documents.title: SEC204 Session rotation
documents.markdown: Refresh credentials expire after thirty days. An expired refresh credential forces another authentication challenge even when the browser still has a cookie. Rotate credentials after use and revoke the previous value.

documents.title: SEC205 Hardware authenticators
documents.markdown: Employees enroll physical security keys as a second authentication factor. A backup key prevents lockout if the primary device is lost. Recovery codes are stored separately.

documents.title: SEC206 Access inheritance
documents.markdown: A nested page inherits read permissions from its parent placement. Moving a page can alter the effective audience. Explicit sharing grants are evaluated along its ancestor chain.

documents.title: SEC207 Credential hygiene
documents.markdown: API credentials belong in the server secret manager. Never include private keys in a browser bundle or application logs. Rotate exposed credentials and remove obsolete grants.

documents.title: FIN301 Billing documents
documents.markdown: A supplier invoice records an amount owed for delivered goods. Finance checks the purchase order, approves the invoice and schedules an outgoing payment before its due date.

documents.title: FIN302 Customer reimbursements
documents.markdown: Support verifies the original card charge before issuing a refund. Reimbursements return funds to the original payment method. The order history records the reason and refunded amount.

documents.title: FIN303 Employee expenses
documents.markdown: Staff submit travel receipts for reimbursement. Managers approve eligible meals, transport and accommodation. Finance rejects duplicate claims and expenses outside the travel policy.

documents.title: FIN304 Subscription continuation
documents.markdown: Annual contracts renew automatically unless cancelled before the notice deadline. Account owners receive reminders ninety days before expiry and confirm the next service period.

documents.title: OPS401 Recovery copies
documents.markdown: Nightly PostgreSQL backups are encrypted and copied to a separate region. Monthly restore drills verify that archives can recreate pages and relational constraints. Retention is thirty days.

documents.title: OPS402 Read replicas
documents.markdown: Read replicas asynchronously receive changes from the primary database. Replication lag can cause a freshly edited record to be missing temporarily. Critical reads use the primary connection.

documents.title: OPS403 Deferred jobs
documents.markdown: A durable outbox stores background work in the same transaction as application changes. A publisher notifies the broker. Consumers claim persisted jobs with leases and retry interrupted work.

documents.title: OPS404 Worker fencing
documents.markdown: Every execution claim increments a fencing counter. Publication checks both the current counter and source revision. A slow worker cannot overwrite output published by a newer execution.

documents.title: NET501 Domain resolution
documents.markdown: DNS maps a host name to an IP address. A stale resolver cache can point clients at an old server until the record TTL expires. Flush the cache after changing the destination.

documents.title: NET502 Certificate renewal
documents.markdown: TLS certificates prove endpoint identity and encrypt transport. Automated renewal runs before expiry. An expired certificate causes browsers to reject otherwise healthy HTTPS connections.

documents.title: NET503 Request throttling
documents.markdown: The gateway limits requests per account per minute. Clients receiving HTTP 429 should honor Retry-After and use exponential backoff with jitter. Repeated immediate retries increase congestion.

documents.title: NET504 Cache invalidation
documents.markdown: A query cache key includes workspace, account and search mode. Mutations invalidate affected entries. Cached result membership never replaces live authorization at the server.

documents.title: AI601 Semantic representations
documents.markdown: An embedding converts a text passage into a numeric vector. Nearby vectors tend to express similar meaning. Cosine distance compares their direction rather than their magnitude.

documents.title: AI602 Source segmentation
documents.markdown: Long Markdown pages are split along headings and paragraph boundaries. Overlap preserves nearby context. Every segment retains its page identity, heading ancestry and source range.

documents.title: AI603 Answer evidence
documents.markdown: Search returns candidate locations. The assistant must read the authorized live page or record before citing content. A stored snippet or similarity score alone is insufficient evidence.

documents.title: AI604 Unsupported claims
documents.markdown: An answer must distinguish retrieved facts from speculation. If the available sources do not support a claim, the assistant says the information was not found. Fabricated citations are rejected.

documents.title: HR701 New starters
documents.markdown: Before the first day, IT provisions a laptop and workspace account. The manager assigns a buddy and schedules an introduction. A checklist tracks equipment delivery and training completion.

documents.title: HR702 Time away
documents.markdown: Employees request annual leave through the team calendar. Managers check coverage before approval. Approved absences update the staffing schedule and remaining allowance.

documents.title: HR703 Candidate assessment
documents.markdown: Interviewers use a consistent role rubric and submit independent feedback before the debrief. Hiring decisions compare demonstrated skills against requirements rather than personal affinity.

documents.title: OPS405 Incident response
documents.markdown: The on-call engineer assesses impact and starts an incident channel. A commander coordinates mitigation while a separate scribe records the timeline. Follow-up actions are assigned after recovery.

documents.title: ENG801 Release rollout
documents.markdown: A release starts in staging, then reaches a small production cohort. Error rates and latency are monitored before increasing traffic. Feature flags control admission of new capabilities.

documents.title: ENG802 Test isolation
documents.markdown: Integration suites create dedicated databases and brokers with unique names. Fake HTTP providers make failure behavior reproducible. Cleanup removes only resources owned by the current test run.

documents.title: ENG803 UTF-8 boundaries
documents.markdown: UTF-8 characters occupy variable numbers of bytes. Byte-limited text splitting iterates Unicode code points and never cuts inside an encoded character. Emoji and CJK fixtures detect broken boundaries.

documents.title: ENG804 Cursor traversal
documents.markdown: Large collections use keyset pagination ordered by a stable identifier. The next request starts after the last identifier seen. A captured high-water mark bounds a long-running scan.

documents.title: SPACE901 Launch operations
documents.markdown: A rocket lifts a payload through the atmosphere into its planned trajectory. The launch team tracks weather, fueling and countdown gates. A scrub postpones departure without changing the payload mission.

documents.title: SPACE902 Orbital maintenance
documents.markdown: A satellite circles Earth along a predictable orbital path. Small thruster burns correct drift and avoid debris. Ground stations monitor position and fuel reserves throughout the mission.

documents.title: BIO903 Reef ecology
documents.markdown: Coral reefs support diverse marine communities in warm shallow seas. Rising water temperatures cause bleaching when corals lose symbiotic algae. Local conservation reduces additional stress.

documents.title: BIO904 Abyss exploration
documents.markdown: Submersibles investigate deep ocean environments where sunlight cannot reach. Pressure-resistant vessels carry cameras and sampling arms. Hydrothermal vents support life through chemical energy.
